text.description_html:
Acorn APDBP, Spade Cast Iron Garden Gate Pull

This cast iron pull exudes an old world charm onto any home. Its spade shape is similar to a plant leaf so it will look great on your garden gate or atrium door but it can be used for any lightweight door both inside and outside your home. Plus, with only six screws, it's easy to install. The beautiful smooth black iron finish has a lifetime no rust warranty.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Specification for the Acorn APDBP Spade Gate Pull:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Height: 7-3/4"
  • Width: 2"
  • Projection: 1-5/8"
  • Material: Cast Iron
  • Lifetime No-Rust Finish Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.
